2607.21595.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
2607.21595.paper_summary: Despite rapid progress, most existing vision-language models (VLMs) built from 2D visual inputs often struggle when handling various 3D tasks that require fine-grained spatial understanding and reasoning. To bridge this gap, we present VLM-IE3D, a unified framework that enhances the 3D spatial awareness of VLMs by equipping them with both implicit and explicit 3D geometries learned from RGB videos. Our VLM-IE3D introduces Implicit Geometry Tokens (IGTs) that capture high-level geometric priors from input videos, as well as complementary Explicit Geometry Tokens (EGTs) that encode detailed geometric structures from reconstructed 3D attributes. On top of that, VLM-IE3D comes with a 3D-aware adapter that effectively fuses the two types of geometric representations with 2D visual cues. This RGB-only design injects strong 3D inductive biases for fine-grained spatial understanding and reasoning without requiring any additional 3D inputs. Extensive experiments show that VLM-IE3D achieves superior performance consistently across various 3D tasks including 3D video detection, 3D visual grounding, 3D dense captioning, and spatial reasoning. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Vegetebird/VLM-IE3D.
2607.21595.paper_summary_zh: 儘管進展迅速，但大多數現有的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）在處理需要細緻空間理解和推理的各種3D任務時，往往面臨挑戰。為了縮小這一差距，我們提出了VLM-IE3D，一個統一框架，通過為VLM配備從RGB視頻學習的隱式和顯式3D幾何來增強其3D空間感知。我們的VLM-IE3D引入了隱式幾何標記（IGTs），這些標記從輸入視頻中捕捉高級幾何先驗，還有互補的顯式幾何標記（EGTs），這些標記編碼了從重建的3D屬性中提取的詳細幾何結構。除此之外，VLM-IE3D還配備了一個3D感知適配器，能有效地將這兩種幾何表示與2D視覺線索融合。這種僅使用RGB的設計為細緻的空間理解和推理注入了強大的3D歸納偏見，而無需任何額外的3D輸入。大量實驗表明，VLM-IE3D在各種3D任務中，包括3D視頻檢測、3D視覺定位、3D密集標題生成和空間推理，始終達到卓越的性能。代碼和模型可在https://github.com/Vegetebird/VLM-IE3D獲得。
